title: How is Hitler connected to Shrek?
description:
Seven real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Shrek, through Hindenburg, Kaiser Wilhelm II, King George V, Queen Elizabeth II, Justin Trudeau and Mike Myers.

Adolf Hitler → Paul von Hindenburg → Wilhelm II, German Emperor → George V → Elizabeth II → Justin Trudeau → Mike Myers → Shrek

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Hindenburg: In 1933, Hitler shook hands with President Hindenburg, who made him chancellor.
   Photo, CC BY-SA 3.0 de: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bundesarchiv_Bild_183-S38324,_Tag_von_Potsdam,_Adolf_Hitler,_Paul_v._Hindenburg.jpg
2. Hindenburg → Kaiser Wilhelm II: In 1917, Hindenburg planned the war with Kaiser Wilhelm II.
   Photo by Robert Sennecke, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hindenburg,_Kaiser,_Ludendorff_HD-SN-99-02150.JPG
3. Kaiser Wilhelm II → King George V: In 1910, the Kaiser posed at Windsor with his cousin, King George V.
   Photo by W. & D. Downey, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Nine_Sovereigns_at_Windsor_for_the_funeral_of_King_Edward_VII.jpg
4. King George V → Queen Elizabeth: In 1933, George V stood on the palace balcony with little Princess Elizabeth.
   Photo by Central News Agency / Agence Rol, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:3-5_(i.e._6)-33,_anniversaire_du_roi_George_V_(la_famille_royale_au_balcon_de_Buckingham_Palace)_-_btv1b532749892.jpg
5. Queen Elizabeth → Justin Trudeau: In 2021, the Queen hosted Justin Trudeau at the G7 in Cornwall.
   Photo by Number 10, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Prime_Minister_Boris_Johnson_G7_Summit_Day_One_-_51242021245.jpg
6. Justin Trudeau → Mike Myers: In 2016, Trudeau greeted fellow Canadian Mike Myers at the White House.
   Photo by Justin Trudeau on Twitter (via The Quint), Fair use (commentary): https://www.thequint.com/news/world/when-trudeau-tangoed-his-way-to-washington-and-into-our-hearts
7. Mike Myers → Shrek: And in 2001, Mike Myers became the voice of Shrek.
   Photo by DoD News, DreamWorks Pictures (via IMP Awards), CC BY 2.0 / Fair use (commentary): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mike_Myers_2017_(37220071326)_(cropped).jpg + http://www.impawards.com/2001/shrek_ver3.html

Research notes: Edward VII's 1910 funeral put the Kaiser in one photo with his cousin George V; the royals carry the chain to Trudeau, who greeted Mike Myers at a White House dinner.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #shrek #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment:
Fun fact from the research: Kaiser Wilhelm II and King George V were first cousins, both grandsons of Queen Victoria, yet led opposite sides in World War I.

Who should Hitler connect to next? Name anyone (a character works too) and I'll find the photos.
